difficulty_reason: The author combines relativized reflection principles, a specialized switching lemma and index-width/admissible-restriction arguments. The disjunction result separates two individually hard formulas with a short joint refutation; the automatability result uses a runtime gap to reduce3-SAT with preserved time-class assumptions.
